hooks.command: bash -c 'root="$PWD"; cli=""; while [ "$root" != "/" ] && [ -z "$cli" ]; do for n in data-harness-cli data-harness-cli.exe; do [ -f "$root/bin/$n" ] && cli="$root/bin/$n"; done; root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; if [ -z "$cli" ]; then echo "data-harness-cli not found from $PWD" >&2; exit 1; fi; "$cli" context --format codex-hook'

root="$PWD"; while [ "$root" != "/" ] && [ ! -x "$root/bin/data-harness-cli" ]; do root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; if [ ! -x "$root/bin/data-harness-cli" ]; then echo "data-harness-cli not found from $PWD" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$root/bin/data-harness-cli" authz-hook --agent codex

bash -c 'root="$PWD"; cli=""; while [ "$root" != "/" ] && [ -z "$cli" ]; do for n in data-harness-cli data-harness-cli.exe; do [ -f "$root/bin/$n" ] && cli="$root/bin/$n"; done; root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; if [ -z "$cli" ]; then echo "data-harness-cli not found from $PWD" >&2; exit 1; fi; "$cli" posttool --format codex-hook'
